topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I can't believe it, it's Mr. Thompson all over again. When I found out my kid had him as a teacher, my heart just sank a little. I loved Mr. Thompson, but man, I remember some of the stories I told you about his class. All those awkward moments, the time he called on me in front of everyone, and I froze. I just hope my kid has an easier time, a better time. I wish I could smooth the path for them, make sure they don’t stumble like I did. Guess all I can do now is be there to listen, to help, and hope that this time around, it turns out better.
